bindings.requestId: Every response carries the initiating requestId; both peers reject a mismatch.
bindings.origin: The fill request carries one normalized page origin. The desktop matches it against saved login URLs and rechecks the same relationship under the vault lock before release.
bindings.matchKind: Names the rule the desktop enforced when it released the credential: exact, or wwwAlias for the single www form of a bare hostname. The desktop recomputes the rule before release; the extension reads it to explain the match.
bindings.expiry: Not transmitted as caller-controlled data. The desktop owns the 30-second deadline and rechecks the pending request, connection, vault session epoch, and deadline before release.
